title: Strategy Health
error: Strategy health could not be loaded. Retry when the data service is available.
invalidThresholds: Enter percentiles between 0 and 100, with the structural warning percentile above the review percentile. IC thresholds must be at least as cautious as CM thresholds.
noDefault: Choose a default portfolio containing CM or IC to see its health summary.
notSelected: This selection does not contain Century Momentum or Inflation Compass.
simulation: Historical simulation using original USD implementations, before fees, tax and deposits. SPY adjusted close is the S&P 500 total-return ETF proxy. These are completed monthly holding-period results, not your live account returns. Health uses all available history through the selected end date, regardless of the Backtest start date.
weights: Uses configured sleeve weights and the existing monthly portfolio rebalancing engine. Each CM or IC group is normalized within that group. Combined portfolio includes all configured sleeves.
method: Drawdown measures the loss from the previous monthly peak, including starting capital. Each earlier recovered fall contributes its deepest loss and its full recovery time once. The ongoing fall is excluded from its own reference. Relative performance subtracts SPY’s annualized 36-month return from the strategy’s. Earlier comparison windows cannot overlap the current 3-year window. Historical rolling windows still overlap each other.
limits: These editable tail percentiles are diagnostic choices, not validated failure probabilities. CM defaults use the worst 10% and 2.5% of history. IC defaults flag earlier, at the worst 20% and 5%, because model fitting may make its historical results look too reassuring. A portfolio containing IC uses the IC policy. Historical thresholds cannot prove that a strategy has stopped working.
sample: The existing minimums remain 36 earlier drawdown observations (now whole recovered falls), 3 recovered underwater episodes and 36 earlier rolling windows. Fewer complete observations means Insufficient data. Structural Warning requires at least two measures in their structural warning zones and enough observations in each tail. One measure alone can produce Review. No verified independent live calibration is available.
monitor: Continue monitoring the next completed month. All three indicators are within the configured historical review thresholds.
missingAction: Check the available dates and data sources. A complete historical comparison is needed before assigning a health rating.
drawdownAction: Review the depth of the loss against earlier drawdowns, then check the signals and holdings. A rare historical loss does not establish strategy failure.
underwaterAction: Review how long recovery is taking compared with earlier recovered episodes, then check the signals and holdings.
relativeAction: Review the sustained performance gap against SPY, including differences in market exposure. Check signal execution before drawing conclusions.
technicalAction: Check signals, dated prices and fund mappings first. Resolve implementation issues before interpreting the performance warning.
missingData: Some required data is missing or invalid.
staleData: The latest available holding period predates the latest completed monthly execution period. Review dated source data.
historyUnavailable: The existing engine could not produce a complete history for this selection.
holdingsUnavailable: Holdings or current signal valuations are unavailable. Open Today to check the saved portfolio and prices.
holdingsAction: Review the holdings comparison on Today. A weight difference can reflect market drift or cash, so confirm quantities and completed signals before taking action.
trackingUnavailable: Insufficient data for a comparable total-return tracking test. The app has no verified currency/hedging-matched total-return benchmark for this local fund. Native-price co-movement alone cannot establish tracking quality.
changesUnavailable: No reliable instrument-change event feed is connected. Source identifiers and documented implementation differences are shown below.
mappingMismatch: Published identifier differs from the configured execution security. Review the source and instrument mapping.
mappingUnavailable: The source does not provide a verifiable instrument identifier.
mappingKnown: Configured and published instrument identifiers agree.
icHedge: The IC utilities fund is ILS-hedged, an explicitly documented exposure difference from the original US fund.
noLocal: No Israeli execution proxies in this selection.
checksNote: Implementation findings are independent of the historical performance rating. A data issue can prevent a rating. These checks never create an order.
thresholdStored: Thresholds are saved in this browser only. Changing a field takes effect when Apply thresholds is pressed.
reasonTemplate: {metric} is at historical stress percentile {percentile}, exceeding the {threshold} review threshold.
structuralTemplate: {metric} is in its structural warning zone above percentile {threshold}. Review the model assumptions and execution. One measure alone cannot create an overall Structural Warning.
shortSample: The historical comparison sample is too small for all three indicators.
gap: The history contains missing, invalid or nonconsecutive monthly holding periods.
sourceWarning: The loader reported degraded market data.
mismatch: Holdings differ from current signal targets.
matched: Holdings match current signal targets at the available valuation.
drift: Configured target and actual weights are shown as fractions.
historicalCheck: Holdings checks use today’s saved account, independently of the historical analysis date.
stalePrice: The latest published local price predates the last completed TASE session. Check its publication schedule and feed before interpreting performance.
compactNote: Simulated original USD strategies · completed monthly results · SPY benchmark.
shortMonitor: Continue monitoring the next completed month.
shortMissing: Check the history and source dates before interpreting this rating.
shortDrawdown: Investigate the loss and confirm signals and holdings.
shortUnderwater: Review the recovery time and confirm signals and holdings.
shortRelative: Review the sustained gap versus SPY and confirm signal execution.
staleInput: The latest signal input predates the last completed US exchange session. Check the dated source feed.
inputDateNote: Macro dates are checked for a missing completed signal month. Day-by-day freshness remains unassessed because the release calendar differs from exchange sessions.
staleMacro: The macro series has no observation in the latest completed signal month. Check the release dates and feed.
ahead: Ahead of the S&P 500 by {value} a year
behind: Behind the S&P 500 by {value} a year
level: Level with the S&P 500 over 3 years
allSleeves: Combined uses all {count} configured sleeves at their saved weights.
missingUsdMapping: {sleeve} has no configured USD mapping. Its history cannot be included in the all-sleeve portfolio.
missingSleeveHistory: {sleeve} could not load or validate complete USD history through {underlying}. Check that sleeve’s source data.
combinedEngineFailure: The combined engine could not align {sleeve} with the other configured sleeves. Check its executable holding periods.
priceAgeOne: {identifier} · Price is dated {date}, one trading day old. Signals are not affected (they use US index data).
priceAgeMany: {identifier} · Price is dated {date}, {days} trading days old. Signals are not affected (they use US index data).
priceAgeUnknown: {identifier} · The price date or TASE calendar is unavailable, so trading-day age cannot be checked.
datedPrice: {identifier} · Price is dated {date}. Check its source and publication schedule.

summaries.structural: At least two measures are in structural warning zones.
summaries.insufficient: More complete history is needed for a rating.

sampleShortfall: {metric} has {available} complete reference observations; {required} are required.
missingHealthBenchmark: {sleeve} resolves to {underlying}, but its health data loader is missing the SPY benchmark series needed for comparison.
